peft.standalone: Nin LoRA / PEFT adapter ka kan ka a ka basi modeli dafa. Basi don ani ka adapter fara a kan Safetensors dilani la; adapter ka bonya kelenkelen tɛ memori ye min kan ka labaara.
peft.attach: Ka LoRA / PEFT adapter fara a kan
peft.description: Sugandili bɛ se ka kɛ model sigiju bɛ la sanfɛ, o kɔfɛ a ka adapter ka folder. Adapter kelen ye model sigiju tɛ. Basis identity kan ka bɛn adapter configuration ma.
peft.estimate: Conservative CPU estimation at 2,048 tokens. Calculated again for the selected device and context at loading time. Target modules and tensor shapes are checked during loading.

noInstalledModels: Modeli min tara nin category la té.
limitedSupport: A bɛ se ka kɛ nin baarakɛla nin ma se ka labaara ka temɛ bɛ kan. A bɛ se ka kɛ ka baarakɛcogow (misali, ɲɛnɛmaya, kumakan) don awtomatiki la - ka modeli fara a kan ani ka a ka baarakɛcogow labɛn ka ta model kelen kelen na.
mlxExperimental: MLX ka dɛmɛ ye sɛgɛsɛgɛli ye. Embeddings tɛ sɔrɔ, ka hakilina toggle ma sɔrɔ hali sisan, ani model architectures kura dow bɛ se ka ban. Ka gɛlɛyaw jira GitHub kan walasa ka se ka u ɲɛsi.
engineBundled: Inference motɛriman bɛ don Novera kɔnɔ, o la fɛn dɔ tɛ min na ka don walima ka ɲɛnamaya kɛrɛfɛ. Citi nin ɲɛnamaya in tuma min na a bɛ modeli dɔ kofɔ min tɛ se ka labaara.
engineOtherVersion: llama.cpp fɔrisiɔn wɛrɛ de ka kan? K'a yɛrɛ ka llama-server labaara ani ka a fara a kan i n'a fɔ OpenAI yɛrɛ ka baarakɛla.
refreshModelsError: Baarakɛla ka kan ka basi URL sɔrɔ ani a ka dɔgɔn ni do ye API ꞃɔgon na walasa ka suguyaw sɔrɔ.
refreshModelsSuccess: A ye {{count}} modɛli kuraw fara a kan ka bɔ {{provider}} la.
noNewModels: Modè koura tɛ sɔrɔ. Modè bè ka se ka fara a kan.
refreshModelsFailed: A ma se ka suguyaw sɔrɔ ka bɔ {{provider}}. K'a fɔ, sɛgɛsɛgɛ kɔkan API ani sigiju URL.
backendHistoryEmpty: Backend ka fisayaliw ma sɔrɔ hali sisan.
embeddingModelsDesc: Ka baara kɛ ni RAG ani vektor ɲinini ye. Sugalen cogoya bɛ kɛ default ye tuma min na ka embeddings dilan.

importedTooltip: Ka fara a kan ka bɔ local file la. Ka a bila ka bɔ Novera ma a bila ka bɔ diski kan.
